newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's Digitel IPO priced at 3.00 pesos per shr.
newsitem.headline: Manila's Digitel IPO priced at 3.00 pesos per shr.

text.p: The Digital Telecommunications Philippines Inc (Digitel) had set the offering price for its 1.271 billion common shares at 3.00 pesos per share, issue manager PCI Capital Corp said on Saturday.
The shares will be sold through an initial public offering from October 30 until November 11.
The price is about 10 to 11 times the price earnings ratio for its 1997 projected net income, PCI told Reuters.
A total of 381,418,000 shares will be offered to domestic investors, while the remaining 889,977,000 are earmarked for foreign investors.
Digitel is the second largest provider of fixed-line telecommunications services in the country after Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co (PLDT).
The issue is tentatively set to be listed on November 27.
